{
  "kind": "GenerationTrace",
  "version": 1,
  "component_id": "project_generation",
  "status": "ready_for_runtime_execution",
  "inputs_considered": [
    "raw_user_goal",
    "selected_requirement",
    "acceptance_contract",
    "online_input_examples",
    "project_goal_constraints",
    "runtime_context",
    "prior_manifest",
    "repair_scope"
  ],
  "prior_manifest_respected": true,
  "prior_manifest_paths": [
    "customer_service/project_request.json",
    "customer_service/intake_summary.md"
  ],
  "paths_generated_by_this_component": [
    "project_generation/blueprint.json",
    "project_generation/generation_trace.json"
  ],
  "duplicate_path_policy": "No prior_manifest path duplicated.",
  "decision_log": [
    {
      "decision": "Generate only project_generation-owned planning artifacts.",
      "reason": "The requested component owns blueprint and generation trace; runtime files belong to runtime_execution."
    },
    {
      "decision": "Steer runtime build toward tiny local notes CLI.",
      "reason": "The raw customer goal explicitly asks for a tiny local notes CLI; generated blueprint must not silently expand into an unrelated full video workbench."
    },
    {
      "decision": "Retain honest degraded-mode evidence requirements.",
      "reason": "The acceptance context and project_goal_constraints require clear local model missing/capability reporting."
    },
    {
      "decision": "Use Open-Meteo as the public API evidence source.",
      "reason": "The online input example provides an Open-Meteo JSON sample suitable for deterministic API evidence tests."
    },
    {
      "decision": "Avoid binary artifacts and generated runtime evidence in this component.",
      "reason": "Runtime execution owns runnable files and artifacts; this component only defines contracts."
    }
  ],
  "handoff_to_runtime_execution": {
    "required_outputs": [
      "README.md",
      "TEST_PLAN.md",
      "pyproject.toml",
      "notes_cli package",
      "tests package"
    ],
    "recommended_runtime_commands": [
      "python -m pytest",
      "python -m notes_cli.cli add --title \"First note\" --body \"Hello local notes\"",
      "python -m notes_cli.cli list --json",
      "python -m notes_cli.cli api-evidence --out evidence/api_evidence.json",
      "python -m notes_cli.cli model-evidence --out evidence/local_model_evidence.json"
    ],
    "evidence_expectations": [
      "api_evidence.json includes source Open-Meteo and response key summary.",
      "local_model_evidence.json reports missing_model when no local command is configured.",
      "test report states whether network-dependent checks used live API or offline sample."
    ]
  },
  "risk_controls": [
    "Do not implement fake local model success.",
    "Do not make network access mandatory for basic notes usage or unit tests.",
    "Do not write outside project root.",
    "Do not duplicate customer_service files.",
    "Do not replace README/TEST_PLAN ownership in project_generation."
  ],
  "component_acceptance_gate": {
    "gate": "Validated project blueprint and generation trace",
    "status": "pass",
    "evidence": [
      "Blueprint defines concrete runtime file plan and CLI contract.",
      "Trace records ownership, path policy, handoff, and risk controls.",
      "No whole project was generated by this component."
    ]
  }
}
